text.tspan: Dioxus) for browsing and editing Aurora models, including live
Aurora Model Source Files — Aurora model source-of-truth files
stored as JSJSON: a mission card plus per-card files under
Desktop UI Shell — Ability to present a desktop
application UI with a stable three-pane layout and shared
Navigation and Focus Management — Ability to navigate the model
by card id and keep the focused card synchronized across panes.
Context Graph Visualization — Ability to visualize a local
subgraph around the focused card (including parent, siblings, and
children) and navigate by clicking nodes.
Interactive Card Editing — Ability to edit card fields and
links interactively while maintaining model invariants and
Markdown Preview and Audit View — Ability to render the focused
card as a readable Markdown-style document with link list, and to
aurora_shared Integration — Ability to reuse aurora_shared for
model discovery/loading, validation, rendering, and file layout
conventions to keep editor behavior consistent with CLI tooling.
Dioxus App Shell — Top-level Dioxus component that owns the UI
shell layout and routes focus/selection changes between panes.
Explorer Tree Pane — Left navigation pane that presents a tree
view derived from shortest paths from the mission root, enabling
fast card discovery and focus changes.
Brain Graph Pane — Central pane that renders a mind-map /
TheBrain-style context graph with the focused card centered and
related cards positioned by relationship role.
Inspector Pane — Right pane that splits vertically: top half
edits the focused card; bottom half shows a rendered
Markdown-style preview (and links) with a tab to reveal audit
Model Session and Persistence — In-memory model session that
loads a workspace model home, computes shortest paths, validates
changes, and persists updated card files using aurora_shared
Workspace File System — Filesystem-backed store holding Aurora
model source files (Mission card plus per-card JSJSON files)
Three Pane Shell — Render the editor UI as three primary
panes: left navigation tree, central context graph, and right
Compute Shortest Path Tree — Compute a stable shortest-path
parent for each card from the mission root and present it as a tree
for navigation (one chosen path per node).
Brain Style Graph View — Render a TheBrain-like local context
view: focused card centered; show parent from the chosen
shortest-path chain; show siblings (same card_type) as adjacent
nodes linked from the parent; show focused card’s outgoing
Card Inspector Editing — Edit the focused card’s core
and links) with immediate validation feedback.
Preview and Audit Panel — Render a Markdown-style card preview
(including outgoing link list) and provide a tab to display audit
trail details for the focused card.
Load, Validate, and Save Models — Load Aurora models from a
chosen workspace, validate invariants on every change, and persist
edits back to JSJSON card files using shared aurora_shared
Dioxus UI Framework API — UI framework interface used to declare
layouts, render widgets, and process user events for the standalone
aurora_shared Domain API — Public domain interface (Rust API)
for discovering model homes, loading cards, validating
Local Filesystem API — Contract for reading and writing
Aurora model files on the local filesystem (open, read,
write, atomic replace, and directory enumeration).
Aurora Standalone Editor System — Bounded system that provides a
desktop UI for exploring and editing Aurora models with a three-pane
